summary: V9 QUOTE flow tested end-to-end. Backend pytest (test_v9_quote.py): 10/10 PASSED — customer 403 on submit; deposit 400 before accept ('accept the contractor's quote' message); admin submits Materials £900 + Labour £1500 → quote_status=proposed, quote_amount=2400, price='£2,400', quote_note persisted; customer decline → status=declined and deposit still 400; admin can re-submit after decline (Update quote path); admin/contractor cannot accept own quote (403); customer accept → status=accepted + quote_decided_at set; deposit POST after accept returns https://checkout.stripe.com/... URL with amount=720.0 (30% of £2400); GET contract confirms full persistence. Frontend Playwright (mobile 390x844) on fresh contract contract_065a458a9745: (1) Customer view pre-quote: submit-quote-btn hidden, no accept/decline, pay-deposit hidden — role & deposit gating correct. (2) Admin view: submit-quote-btn visible, accept-quote hidden; opened send-quote modal, filled quote-label-0/1 + quote-amount-0/1 (Materials 900, Labour 1500), live total updated to £2,400; send-quote submitted → 'Awaiting response' pill + 'Update quote' button appear. (3) Customer view of proposed quote: decline-quote & accept-quote visible; submit-quote-btn hidden; pay-deposit still hidden. Declined → 'Declined' pill shown. (4) Admin re-quotes via 'Update quote' button (icon+'Update quote' label) — modal reopens with prefilled items, send-quote works. (5) Customer accepts → 'Accepted' pill + pay-deposit button appears. (6) pay-deposit tap redirects to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... — Stripe Checkout reached. All role gating, quote total math, price update, and deposit unlock verified through the real UI + backend. No mocks. Overall PASS.

react_native_issues.component: shadow* style props (deprecated in RN Web)
react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' repeatedly during navigation. Non-blocking on web but noisy; consider migrating to boxShadow in shared styles. Reference: components/screens using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius.

Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — comes from an RN component (likely Modal/Overlay). Non-blocking. Reference: frontend/app/contract/[id].tsx modal usage or upstream lib.
Warning 'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing'. Expected on RN Web fallback; only cosmetic — no action required for web preview.

action_items: Optional: silence RN-web deprecation warnings by migrating shadow* props to boxShadow and moving pointerEvents into style.
Consider adding a testID on the Quote-card status pill (e.g. 'quote-status') to make status assertions less brittle than text matching.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py submit_quote: total is recomputed from items when body.amount is None; edge case 'items present but body.amount=0' returns 400 (good). Line-item labels are trimmed and empty labels dropped — solid input hygiene.
server.py respond_quote correctly rejects when quote_status != 'proposed' (400) so accept/decline is idempotent-safe.
server.py _deposit_ready returns quote_status=='accepted' OR fully_signed (legacy). Matches product intent that quote acceptance is the new gate while preserving pre-quote contracts.

server.py submit_quote also sets contract price = _fmt_price(total) so the 'Total price' field on the contract card stays in sync — good. However quote submission does NOT reset customer_signed/contractor_signed if either had signed before a re-quote; not a bug for this feature but worth confirming with product.

frontend contract/[id].tsx: depositReady = quote_status==='accepted' || fullySigned. Matches backend gate. amProSide correctly hides accept/decline for contractor/admin and hides submit-quote for customer.
frontend send-quote modal has KeyboardAvoidingView? Verify TextInput focus on small viewports — not tested in this iteration but appeared functional.
